notes.title: Vengeance 1.1.0.1 - Bug Fixes and Updates
notes.notes: [h1]Patch Notes[/h1][p] Localization[/p][p]	•	Added full language support for:[/p][p]	•	Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian.[/p][p] Visual & UI Updates[/p][p]	•	Main Menu background and UI elements improved.[/p][p]	•	In-game UI enhanced with new indicators for Ruins and Mini-Boss outcomes (success/failure).[/p][p]	•	Entry screen logo sharpened for better clarity.[/p][p]	•	Crosshair design updated.[/p][p]	•	Updated menus:[/p][p]	•	Tab Menu[/p][p]	•	Escape Menu[/p][p]	•	End Game Screen[/p][p]	•	Restart Screen[/p][p]	•	Boss Health Bar redesigned.[/p][p]	•	Added Health Bars to Ruins.[/p][p]	•	Budget symbol updated.[/p][p] Gameplay Balance[/p][p]	•	Mini-Boss[/p][p]	•	Attack Damage nerfed.[/p][p]	•	Boss[/p][p]	•	Special Attack buffed.[/p][p]	•	Turret & Chest unlock time reduced.[/p][p]	•	Flag Defense difficulty slightly increased.[/p][p]	•	Shard item visuals reworked.[/p][p] Achievements[/p][p]	•	16 new achievements added[/p][p] Bug Fixes[/p][p]	•	Fixed an Attack Speed bug that caused inconsistencies in combat pacing.[/p][p]	•	EXP Orbs and leveling now correctly update the player’s EXP and level progression[/p]
